uri11.headline: Human Written
windows: Uridine (the UMP in this protocol) doesn't raise serotonin, so its caution is a different one: within a day of starting it, psychedelics can hit some people a lot harder, visuals included, especially "hard heads" who usually need more than an average dose (I don't have studies on this, only experience like Scott's, whose story is further down). So do not take UMP on the same day as a psychedelic trip, and on your first trip once you're on it, start with a third of your old psychedelic dose. It may also make your dreams more vivid and your cravings weaker, which are the benefits you're hoping for.

ethno11.headline: Human Written
windows: Ethnobotanicals: The plant medicines in this protocol are iboga (an African root bark) and psilocybin mushrooms. Both are illegal in many jurisdictions and carry risks, and iboga can be dangerous for your heart. So never combine iboga with most medications (especially heart & psych meds). If you take any medication, ask an AI whether it's one of them, since AI is pretty good at that (my full iboga guide here lists some of them, and the iboga microdosing protocol is here). Ask the AI about the mushrooms too, since lithium, for one, has been tied to seizures when taken with psychedelics.
